## Objective and acceptance

- Scope and exclusions
- Risk (R0–R3) and reason
- Acceptance criteria and evidence

## Verification

- Base, head and tested integration SHA
- Local checks and CI links, toolchain and limitations
- Review cycle / budget, code and security review links, reviewed SHA and completion times
- Findings fixed, deferred or dismissed with rationale, and remaining blockers

## Handoff

- Stage and next action
- Candidate acceptance, migration and rollback evidence where applicable
- Authorized merge or release scope and integration or version evidence where applicable
